Description:
[list]
[*]How to Use
[/list][list=1]
[list=1]
[*]Load into a save file.
[*]Press the V key (default hotkey) anywhere in the world (make sure no other menus are open).
[*]A pop-up menu will appear with a blank text box.
[*]Type the desired positive gold amount (e.g.,50000).
[*]Click OK or press the Enter key.
[/list][/list]
